landing_subtitle: Upload or capture a leaf photo. AI trained on the PlantDoc dataset identifies the disease, shows where it looked, estimates severity, suggests a treatment, and answers your follow-up questions.
step1_text: Upload a leaf image or use the camera.
step2_text: A YOLOv8 classifier picks the condition (28 PlantDoc classes) and a Grad-CAM heatmap shows why.
step3_text: See severity, plant health and a treatment, then ask the AI assistant follow-up questions.
scan_hint: Tip: one leaf, filling most of the frame, in good light.
results_empty: No scan available. Please go to the Scan page.
heatmap_explain: Red areas influenced the AI's decision most; blue areas least. Shown on the centre square the model looks at.
login_to_save: to save scans to your history.
disclaimer: Decision support only. Confirm with a local agronomist before spraying.
assistant_subtitle: Ask about plant diseases, pests, soil, fertilizers or your latest scan. Powered by Google Gemini.
chat_prefill: My {{plant}} leaf was diagnosed with {{disease}}. What should I do?
chat_empty: Ask a question to start, e.g. "How do I prevent tomato late blight in the rainy season?"
chat_placeholder: Type a plant or farming question…
chat_disclaimer: AI answers can be wrong. Check pesticide labels and ask a local agronomist.
history_login_needed: Log in to see your own scan history. Scans you make while logged in are saved here.
already_account: Already have an account? Log in
